usage.title: Usage
usage.switched.account: Open {provider} chats use {account} starting with the next message.
usage.switched.accountDefault: Open {provider} chats use {account} starting with the next message (and it's now the default).
usage.switched.provider: Open {provider} chats switch to {to} on the next message, in the same chat and branch.

usage.unpricedTurns.one: {count} turn with no cost reported by the agent (Codex and Gemini don't report pricing): USD totals are a minimum; tokens count everything.
usage.unpricedTurns.other: {count} turns with no cost reported by the agent (Codex and Gemini don't report pricing): USD totals are a minimum; tokens count everything.

usage.src.agentStreamsDetail: Claude and Codex report limits every turn
usage.limits.none: No known limits yet: they show up after the first Claude or Codex turn, or with CodexBar installed.
usage.suggest.account: {provider} is near its limit ({title}: {pct}%). Use the {account} account in your chats.
usage.suggest.provider: {provider} is near its limit ({title}: {pct}%). Switch to a {to} model in the same chat.
usage.res.chip: Resource usage of Kabul and its agents
usage.res.title: RESOURCES
usage.res.name: Name
usage.m.costsLimitsSub: Daily spend, account limits and sessions (30 days)
usage.m.kabulChatsFooter: Summed from the turns of chats open on this computer. Full history by workspace, account and day is in the desktop app.
usage.src.codexbarBroken: CodexBar not found (the link points to an app that was removed)
usage.connect.claude: Sign in to Claude Code with this account (run `claude`): Kabul reads the subscription limits straight from Anthropic and on every turn.
usage.connect.codex: Sign in to Codex with this account (`codex login`): Kabul asks the Codex app-server for the limits.
usage.connect.agy: Antigravity doesn't report limits to Kabul; with CodexBar installed they show up here.
usage.connect.other: This provider doesn't report limits to Kabul.
usage.code.noLogin: No Claude Code sign-in for this account: sign in to Claude Code (run `claude`).
usage.code.expired: The Claude Code sign-in expired: sign in to Claude Code again (run `claude`).
usage.code.unauthorized: Anthropic rejected the sign-in: sign in to Claude Code again (run `claude`).
usage.code.rateLimited: Anthropic is rate limiting usage checks; Kabul tries again in a few minutes.
usage.code.network: No connection to read the limits right now.
usage.pin.full: The icon shows up to 3 limits: remove one first
usage.tray.pickHint: Tick up to {max} limits here or use the pin on each block.
usage.tray.noneAvailable: No known limits to choose from yet.
usage.tray.windowsNote: On Windows the tray shows no text next to the icon: percentages and spend go in the tooltip (hover it).
usage.tray.off: The icon is off in Settings › General › Menu bar icon.
